title: SAP Success Factor Solution Architect
description:
IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY !! Exp- 8+ years Location- Bangalore and Coimbatore Mandatory Skills- Architect, Success Factors, Employee Central 

 Job Summary: 
 We are seeking a highly skilled SAP SuccessFactors Solution Architect to design, implement, and deliver end-to-end SAP SuccessFactors solutions. The role requires deep technical and functional expertise, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead diverse project teams. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in driving digital HR transformation and ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems.
 Key Responsibilities: Design and implement scalable, integrated SAP SuccessFactors solutions across modules like Employee Central (EC), Talent Management, Compensation, Learning, Recruitment, and others. Translate business requirements into innovative solutions, leveraging SAP SuccessFactors best practices. Ensure alignment with client HR strategy and enterprise architecture. Lead and guide project teams through all phases of implementation, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Oversee the integration of SAP SuccessFactors with third-party systems, payroll, and core ERP solutions (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, SAP Payroll). Manage risk, resolve escalations, and ensure delivery within budget and timelines. Work closely with HR, IT, and business teams to understand their needs and provide effective solutions. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic guidance on HR digital transformation initiatives. Conduct solution reviews to ensure the architecture aligns with industry standards, compliance requirements, and scalability needs. Drive end-to-end testing, data migration validation, and performance optimization. Stay updated on SAP SuccessFactors innovations and trends to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Mentor and train junior consultants and team members. Contribute to pre-sales activities, including proposal development, effort estimation, and client presentations. 
 Requirements: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, HR, or a related field. Deep expertise in SAP SuccessFactors modules (Employee Central is mandatory; additional modules preferred). Strong understanding of HR processes and compliance requirements. Knowledge of integration tools (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, MuleSoft). Hands-on experience in SAP Payroll or SAP S/4HANA integration is a plus. Minimum 8-12 years of experience in SAP HCM/SuccessFactors implementation and solution architecture. Proven track record of delivering large-scale SAP SuccessFactors projects. Experience working with global clients and managing diverse teams. SAP SuccessFactors certifications (Employee Central and at least one other module) are required. SAP Activate Project Manager certification is a plus. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities. Ability to work independently and in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Key Skills: SAP Success Factor,SAP,Architecture,Saps,Successfactors

title: Finance- Solution Architect
description:
The Oracle ERP Cloud Financials Solution Architect will be responsible for providing leadership, solution expertise, and architectural guidance in the implementation of Oracle ERP Cloud Financials. This role will serve as the key advisor to business stakeholders and implementation teams, ensuring the successful deployment of Oracle ERP Cloud in alignment with organizational objectives, industry best practices, and compliance requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead the overall solution design and architecture for Oracle ERP Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), and Expenses. Partner with finance and business leaders to translate requirements into Oracle ERP Cloud solutions that optimize processes and enhance financial management capabilities. Define architectural standards, integration approaches, and data migration strategies in alignment with corporate IT policies. Oversee end-to-end solution delivery, ensuring high-quality configuration, testing, deployment, and support. Provide functional leadership to cross-functional teams, including business analysts, technical developers, and system integrators. Conduct workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations to gain alignment and approval on design decisions. Establish governance processes to manage changes, customizations, and extensions to Oracle ERP Cloud. Drive knowledge transfer, training, and user enablement to ensure sustainable adoption post-implementation. Stay current with Oracle product updates and industry trends, providing thought leadership on best practices and roadmap opportunities. Reporting To 
 Program Director / Head of ERP Transformation 
 
 Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related discipline. Experience: Minimum 12+ years of ERP implementation experience with at least 3 full-cycle Oracle ERP Cloud Financials implementations in a Solution Architect or similar leadership role. Proven expertise across Oracle ERP Cloud Financials modules with strong functional and architectural design experience. Demonstrated success in leading large-scale ERP transformation projects within complex, global organizations. Skills Competencies 
 Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills. Ability to bridge business requirements with technical solution design. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Knowledge of accounting standards, compliance frameworks, and financial reporting requirements. Good to Have 
 Oracle Fusion Cloud Certification in Financials. Oracle AI Certifications. Preferred Qualifications 
 Oracle ERP Cloud Financials certification(s). Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud or related financial systems. Background in consulting (Big 4 or Tier-1 system integrators). Exposure to multi-country, multi-currency ERP implementations.
